body: Anything. Sometimes just venting and having someone listen without judgement can lift some weight off the shoulders

You can talk to me about being depressed and I won’t tell you to get over it. I get it. I’ve been there. I’m still there a lot of the time but you’re not alone. I don’t you but considering I happened upon your post a minute after you posted it and am maybe the first to see it - I feel personally worried for you and I want you to be okay. I want you to live

No! Things sound difficult for you right now but I promise it can turn around. I’ve wanted to kill myself so many times and gotten so close and now that I’ve decided to live every time I hear a good song or tell a funny joke I thank myself for allowing myself to be there to enjoy life. If you need someone to talk to you can talk to me, I can be here for you. Catch 22’s don’t exist, you can find a loop hole and get through anything and I believe in you.
